card.name: Zero inside trial and study IDs
card.fires_on: The digit 0 inside identifier codes, especially clinical trial numbers (NCT0...), Cochrane codes (CD0...) and study names (BCIRG0..., AG120-C-0...), just before the final digits.

modes.label: Trial registry numbers
modes.description: A zero in the leading digits of an NCT trial registry number.

modes.label: Study and review codes
modes.description: A zero in the number part of a study name or review code.
